coverage_decisions.decision: Reviewed organisation, digestion/food tests, enzymes, circulation, disease/risk and plant transport. Retained practical diagrams, methods and causal-risk caveats. Developed site of enzyme action, specificity/limitation, bile versus lipase, vessel elasticity, treatment selection and guard-cell trade-offs. Rejected SR universal enzyme optima, amylase-to-glucose simplification, and the suggestion a heart transplant removes ongoing medication needs.
